Bug_Details: The skip() method may skip a smaller number of bytes than requested. Check the returned value to find out if it was the case or not.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the skip() method, which may skip fewer bytes than requested. The returned value is checked to determine if the skip was successful.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by calling the skip() method with a larger argument than the available data in the ByteArrayInputStream.
